title: Alcohol: sale, delivery and advertising
summary: Alcohol sale, delivery and advertising is banned or heavily limited across much of the Gulf, North Africa and South Asia, and monopolised or ad-banned in Nordic states. Lawful markets (EU, US, UK, etc.) require local age/licence compliance. Subnational: Indian dry states. Most entries come from general knowledge and must be verified by counsel.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Sale, import and advertising of alcohol forbidden; narrow late-2025 access for wealthy non-Muslim residents reported, not open to the public. Conflicting reports.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.note: Alcohol import, sale and possession banned since 1983. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Libya
countries.note: Alcohol banned since the 1970s. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: Banned for Muslims; minorities have limited communal exceptions; no lawful public online sale.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.note: Alcohol banned under Taliban rule.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.note: Ban applies to Muslims; non-Muslims may import limited quantities; no public sale or advertising. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.note: Alcohol ban for Muslims since 1983 Sharia laws; 2020 reforms for non-Muslims, status unclear. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Somalia
countries.note: Alcohol prohibited under Sharia-based law. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.note: Alcohol banned (limited in former Aden). From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Mauritania
countries.note: Alcohol prohibited for Muslims; very limited non-Muslim exceptions. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: Banned for Muslims; licensed sale to non-Muslims only; online sale and advertising unlawful. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: Muslims barred; permits required for non-Muslims/foreigners; advertising banned. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.note: Alcohol only in licensed tourist resorts; not for locals or online sale. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: Sold only via the state-linked distributor to licensed hotels/permit holders; no public online sale or advertising. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Licensed venues/retailers only; advertising and unlicensed online sale prohibited; alcohol licence regime varies by emirate. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Oman
countries.note: Licensed venues and permit holders only; advertising restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.note: Licensed sale to non-Muslims; public advertising and unlicensed online sale not permitted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Algeria
countries.note: Licensed sale only; advertising and online sale restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.note: Sale to Muslims prohibited; licensed outlets only; advertising banned. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.note: Licensed outlets only; advertising banned; limited sale to Muslims. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Licensed sale only; advertising restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: Sale limited to licensed outlets and minimarket restrictions; advertising and online sale restricted; some regions ban alcohol. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: Not for Muslims; licensed non-Muslim sale; advertising restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: Strict advertising ban, online sale restrictions and licensing; sales hour limits. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: India
countries.note: State-level: prohibition in Gujarat, Bihar, Nagaland, Mizoram, Lakshadweep; state licensing and surrogate-ad bans nationwide. Subnational detail in summary. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: Online/distance retail of alcohol prohibited (limited exceptions); advertising restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Norway
countries.note: Vinmonopolet retail monopoly for >4.7% ABV; alcohol advertising banned. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Sweden
countries.note: Systembolaget retail monopoly; strict advertising rules. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Finland
countries.note: Alko monopoly for strong drinks; strict advertising rules. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Iceland
countries.note: ATVR monopoly; alcohol advertising banned. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Lithuania
countries.note: Advertising banned; sale hours and online sale restrictions. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.note: Advertising banned (Alcohol Control Act); online sale limited. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Nepal
countries.note: Strict licensing and advertising ban. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Bhutan
countries.note: Licensed sale with advertising/online restrictions. From general knowledge, unverified.
